title: Real-estate lease administration bundle
description: Tenant certification, lease terms, rent roll, and property-management evidence.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: WorkflowBundle
metadata:
  name: real-estate-lease-administration
  title: Real-estate lease administration bundle
  description: Tenant certification, lease terms, rent roll, and property-management evidence.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  workflowRef: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-acct-02
  ontology:
    ref: ladder://ontologies/builtin/real-estate
    mode: sliver
    selection:
      propertyRefs: [real_property.property_address, real_estate_party.tenant_name, lease.lease_end_date, rent_roll.monthly_scheduled_rent, property_management.management_fee_terms]
      relationshipIds: [describes, has_party, managed_by, summarized_by]
  forms:
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/real_estate/tenant_estoppel_certificate, role: completion }
  documents:
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/real_estate/lease_agreement, role: supporting }
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/real_estate/rent_roll, role: supporting }
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/real_estate/property_management_agreement, role: supporting }
